Ondo Secures FINRA Authorizations

Ondo Finance’s Oasis Pro Markets secures FINRA authorizations (https://d5vnWT04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/RM+113/d5vnWT04/VWXS6v7jy70WW1x6g-G579VCGV7Wb0N5RWNkWN7lCf0b3lcq-W7Y8-PT6lZ3mjW1nQ8Rt7cbDH-W4_xKMC32ptCfN4Hn3mP9NpV3W6HfM7C3QM13DW5g_lP33VkDbXV8dcFT3vPs4kMTf16m5lbqmW1nPp-x7_340_V_Tpmj5_j3gbW5gpJtP6QTTrZW8LYV_y1p7-y0W4yNZDK7lxxXcW7_0mHj5tDXGSW6CGkBk70w-qdN33fxN4ps07SW4bPDYY4srdQtW4gv0cJ5YsM-LW2GBgcc2l5kbSW4LvrZn3glBMnW3Xkybd5ybW5zW7DxyMj3lCFFwW5CSz8j1wp9kmW8WgQ9-8qPTGgW3JY9-33GRq0pW3jksdt7s-G0YW6f7TC88fKgLYf1zlPHj04 ) to offer a broad range of tokenized equities and funds to U.S. investors.
